chunks: Abu Al-Abbas Al-Razzaz from Ayoub ibn Nuh, and Abu Ali Al-Ash'ari from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar, and Muhammad ibn Ismail from Al-Fadl ibn Shadhan, and Humayd ibn Ziyad from Ibn Sama'ah, all of them from Safwan ibn Yahya from Musa ibn Bakr from Zurara from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said:
The woman who is thrice divorced has no maintenance (nafaqah) upon her husband. Rather, it is for the one upon whom her husband has the right of reversion (raj'ah).
ai.seo_question: Does a thrice-divorced woman receive maintenance from her husband?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies that a woman divorced three times (thalath) loses her right to maintenance (nafaqah) because the divorce is final and irrevocable, unlike in a revocable divorce (raj'ah) where she remains entitled. This ruling is rooted in the Shia scholarly understanding that the financial obligation ceases once the waiting period (iddah) concludes without reconciliation, marking the end of the marital bond's immediate legal effects.
